STUDIO V3 / CASSETTE 01

Configure the cassette module.

Three non-residential programs and an experimental Matrix grid. Geometry and placement rules are supplied by OBTP System.

1–18 repeated modules, in 600 mm steps. Fixed 4.572 m setting-out width and 2.1 m walls. Sauna program allowances begin at 8 modules.

Changing/rest occupies the front and accesses both wet blocks. A rear strip left by unequal lengths is reserved for service planning.

Cells coordinate a layout; they are not separate rooms or floor cassettes. This study allows up to eight columns and restricts rows to the outside-wall area cap.

Display offsets only, not an assembly sequence.

Research prototype. Studio, Workshop and Sauna use the revised R90 geometry; Matrix reuses the 600 mm wall family with its own unresolved corners. Plywood skins are hidden to inspect the frame. Contact between modules does not establish connection strength. Fasteners, anchorage, joist spans and envelope details await engineering and physical tests.

Windows and doors: on hold for every preset. Workshop access and sauna wet room subdivisions are program allowances only; no opening, partition, waterproofing or services are generated. Matrix corners, cassette junctions, perimeter closure and bearing are unengineered.
